subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): surface accountId on agent hook context

question: Should `ctx.accountId` be approved as the canonical public plugin hook-context field, and should the exported helper accept the internal `agentAccountId` alias?
rationale: This changes public plugin SDK surface; automation can identify the alias risk but cannot choose the permanent SDK contract or deprecation policy for maintainers.

options.title: Approve Field And Remove Alias
options.body: Approve `ctx.accountId` as the public field and require internal callers to map `agentAccountId` to `accountId` before calling the exported helper.

options.title: Accept Alias As Public API
options.body: Keep `agentAccountId` only if maintainers want external harness callers to rely on it, with documented precedence, support status, and a removal plan.

options.title: Pause For Naming Direction
options.body: Hold the PR until the account identity field name and helper input contract are settled.

recommendation.title: Approve Field And Remove Alias
recommendation.body: Approve `ctx.accountId` as the public field and require internal callers to map `agentAccountId` to `accountId` before calling the exported helper.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest current history on the plugin hook contract and SDK runtime files affected by this public API decision.
